name: Create or update a repository secret
description: Create or update a repository secret Creates or updates a repository secret with an encrypted value. PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets/{secret_name}

name: Delete a repository secret
description: Delete a repository secret Deletes a secret in a repository using the secret name. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets/{secret_name}

name: Get a Dependabot alert
description: Get a Dependabot alert OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts/{alert_number}

name: Get a repository public key
description: Get a repository public key Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets/public-key
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets/public-key
Gets your public key, which you need to encrypt secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint if the repository is private.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

name: Get a repository secret
description: Get a repository secret Gets a single repository secret without revealing its encrypted value. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets/{secret_name}

name: List Dependabot alerts for a repository
description: List Dependabot alerts for a repository OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts
OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint. If this endpoint is only used with public repositories, the token can use the `public_repo` scope instead.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: classification (query) — A comma-separated list of vulnerability classifications. If specified, only alerts for vulnerabilities with these classifications will be returned. Can be: `malware`, `general`; state (query) — A comma-separated list of states. If specified, only alerts with these states will be returned. Can be: `auto_dismissed`, `dismissed`, `fixed`, `open`; severity (query) — A comma-separated list of severities. If specified, only alerts with these severities will be returned. Can be: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`; ecosystem (query) — A comma-separated list of ecosystems. If specified, only alerts for these ecosystems will be returned. Can be: `composer`, `go`, `maven`, `npm`, `nuget`, `pip`, `pub`, `rubygems`, `rust`; package (query) — A comma-separated list of package names. If specified, only alerts for these packages will be returned.; manifest (query) — A comma-separated list of full manifest paths. If specified, only alerts for these manifests will be returned.; epss_percentage (query) — CVE Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) percentage. Can be specified as: - An exact number (`n`) - Comparators such as `>n`, `<n`, `>=n`, `<=n` - A range like `n..n`, where `n` is a number from 0.0 to 1.0 Filters the list of alerts based on EPSS percentages. If specified, only alerts with the provided EPSS percentages will be returned.; has (query) — Filters the list of alerts based on whether the alert has the given value. If specified, only alerts meeting this criterion will be returned. Multiple `has` filters can be passed to filter for alerts that have all of the values. Currently, only `patch` is supported.; assignee (query) — Filter alerts by assignees. Provide a comma-separated list of user handles (e.g., `octocat` or `octocat,hubot`) to return alerts assigned to any of the specified users. Use `*` to list alerts with at least one assignee or `none` to list alerts with no assignees.; scope (query) — The scope of the vulnerable dependency. If specified, only alerts with this scope will be returned.; relationship (query) — A comma-separated list of relationships of the vulnerable dependency to your project. If specified, only alerts with these relationships will be returned. > [!NOTE] > We are rolling out support for dependency relationship across ecosystems. This value will be "unknown" for all dependencies in unsupported ecosystems.; sort (query) — The property by which to sort the results. `created` means when the alert was created. `updated` means when the alert's state last changed. `epss_percentage` sorts alerts by the Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) percentage.; direction (query) — The direction to sort the results by.; before (query) — A cursor, as given in the [Link header](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api#using-link-headers). If specified, the query only searches for results before this cursor. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; after (query) — A cursor, as given in the [Link header](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api#using-link-headers). If specified, the query only searches for results after this cursor. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

name: List repository secrets
description: List repository secrets Lists all secrets available in a repository without revealing their encrypted values. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/secrets
Lists all secrets available in a repository without revealing their encrypted values. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
